reason: I already paid for a DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, and this still sends DMs from my own account. Card up front, billing on day 4, and no refunds is exactly how I got stung before, and $147 is a big bite out of what I make.
objection: It's still automation sending from my own Instagram, and I got an action block last time. There are no customer results yet, and if day 4 hits and it hasn't worked, I can't get the money back.
would_change_my_mind: A real refund window, or a trial with no card up front. Failing that, a few named agency owners my size showing replies and booked calls from their own accounts, with no action blocks.
